target_subject: five stylized human figures lying on a multi-tiered bed structure

scene: An overhead view of a red-framed bed with four white pillows at the head, divided into three horizontal sleeping levels.
Three yellow analog alarm clocks with black hands and numerals are placed around the bed; one shows approximately 7:05, another ~10:10, and the third ~12:00.
A small white rectangular paper labeled 'A' lies on the top sleeping level near the headboard.
action: All five figures are supine or prone on the bed, limbs extended in varied positions; none are standing or sitting upright.
One figure on the top level has arms outstretched and legs splayed; another on the same level lies on their side with knees bent.
A figure on the bottom level raises one arm upward while holding a small object; another on the middle level rests face-down with head turned sideways.
rationale: The layered bed suggests intentional spatial organization rather than accidental stacking, as each level is clearly delineated and occupied.
Alarm clocks positioned at different orientations imply time is a thematic element, though no single synchronized time is shown.
The presence of a labeled paper ('A') may indicate categorization or assignment, but its purpose cannot be confirmed from visual evidence alone.
object: The bed has a maroon headboard and footboard with four square white pillows arranged linearly behind the topmost sleeper.

Five distinct human figures are visible: two on the top tier, two on the middle tier, and one on the bottom tier, each wearing solid-colored clothing (black, blue, teal, maroon, pink/red with green shorts).
